content.short: Abstract is a consumer-focused Layer 2 blockchain built on Ethereum using the ZK stack for high speed and low costs.
content.description: Abstract is an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain developed by Igloo Inc., specifically optimized for consumer applications like gaming and social networks. Built using the zkSync ZK stack and EigenDA, it provides a high-speed, low-cost environment for the next generation of decentralized entertainment. The network features the Abstract Global Wallet (AGW), which simplifies onboarding through passkeys and social logins, removing technical barriers for new users. By focusing on cultural alignment and intuitive interfaces, Abstract aims to scale the decentralized economy for everyone worldwide.
content.meta: Abstract is a ZK-powered Layer 2 blockchain designed for consumer crypto and gaming. Discover Abstract and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
